title: Bake determinism contract (spec hard rule) has no durable test — manual --verify only, unrunnable on fresh clones/CI
evidence:
def verify(out_path: str, cache_dir: str) -> None:
    import tempfile
...
            raise SystemExit("[verify] FAIL — re-bake differs! Determinism broken.")
--- diff .gitignore: +.osm-cache/
--- tools/osm_extract.py:276: DEFAULT_CACHE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", ".osm-cache")
detail: Spec rule 2 acceptance ("bake is deterministic") is enforced only by a hand-run subcommand whose input cache is gitignored — CI and fresh clones cannot re-check it; no regression pins the committed asset's invariants.
recommended_fix: Add an offline pin test (test_sprite_order.py precedent): assert dublin.json invariants (sorted spawn_candidates, 0.02 quantization, in-bounds, attribution, board block) and wire it as a lint gate.

title: Board-size constants restated in two new tools with no drift pin against data/balance.json map.*
evidence:
tools/osm_extract.py:73-75:
BOARD_W_TILES = 40
BOARD_H_TILES = 30
TILE_PX = 26
tools/render_dublin_preview.py:30: TILE_PX = 26          # data/balance.json map.tile_px
data/balance.json map: {"w_tiles": 40, "h_tiles": 30, "tile_px": 26}
detail: Values agree today, but a future balance.json map.* change silently desyncs the bake/projection (ODN-5 single-source rule); zero coverage catches drift. Repo precedent pins exactly this class (tools/test_sprite_order.py, lint gate 7).
recommended_fix: Extend the new pin test to assert BOARD_W_TILES/BOARD_H_TILES/TILE_PX == data/balance.json map.* (parse the constants via AST like test_sprite_order.py does).

title: Fetch error-path guard greps XML '<remark>' though queries pin [out:json]; no negative test for partial/truncated 200 responses
detail: Overpass JSON responses carry errors as a "remark" JSON member, not a '<remark>' tag — the substring check can cache truncated 200 data as valid, and this path has zero tests.
recommended_fix: json.loads the body and check a 'remark' key; add a negative unit test feeding a 200-with-remark fixture through _post_one and asserting rejection.

title: render_dublin_preview.py palette lookups fail silently to opaque black; no negative test
detail: A renamed/missing palette token silently paints black instead of failing; repo memlog records fallback-drift as a real trap class. Happy path verified: all keys exist and all 9 committed PNGs re-render byte-identically.
recommended_fix: Raise on missing key (or assert all required tokens up-front); add a negative test with a stub palette missing one token.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% under the spec's own verification model (user look-gate APPROVE recorded in asset rulings; zero sim/golden diff — diff touches only .gitignore/.memlog.md plus new files; ODbL attribution verified in asset). P1 ~85%: determinism proven once manually (--verify PASS; all 9 previews re-render byte-identical) but 0% durable. Overall ≥80% demonstrated, 0% durable automated.
recommended_fix: Add tools/test_dublin_asset.py offline pin (asset invariants + balance.json map.* == tool constants) wired as a lint gate; fix the JSON remark guard with a negative test. That lifts P1 ≥90% and the gate to PASS.
